annotation.title_clean: Strategia Nazionale per l'Intelligenza Artificiale (Bozza per la consultazione)
annotation.title_en: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence (Draft for consultation)
annotation.summary_en: Italy's draft National AI Strategy (July 2019, Ministry of Economic Development) for consultation. It sets nine objectives, including investment, research, SME adoption, education, data economy, ethical and regulatory framework, public trust, public administration and EU cooperation, centred on human-centric, trustworthy and sustainable AI. It has no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine objectives: investment, research ecosystem, adoption, education, data economy, regulatory/ethical framework, trust, public administration, EU cooperation
Seven priority sectors: manufacturing, agri-food, tourism and culture, infrastructure and energy, health, smart cities and mobility, public administration
Anthropocentric, trustworthy and sustainable AI as guiding principles
National AI network built on Competence Centers and Digital Innovation Hubs
Contributes to the EU Coordinated Plan on AI and aligns with AI Watch and the OECD AI Policy Observatory
